dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 04, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Padres Fall to Phillies in Thrilling 6-4 Showdown**

In a back-and-forth contest, the Philadelphia Phillies outlasted the San Diego Padres 6-4, thanks in large part to Zack Wheeler's dominant 7-inning performance. Wheeler struck out 8 and allowed just 2 earned runs to earn the win. Jackson Merrill led the Padres offense with a 2-RBI homer, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Phillies' late-inning surge. Meanwhile, Bryce Johnson added a late RBI single to keep the Padres' hopes alive.

**Orioles Rout Red Sox 8-2 Behind Contreras' Power**

The Baltimore Orioles cruised to an 8-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Willson Contreras leading the charge. Contreras homered for the 12th time this season, driving in 2 runs to pace the Orioles' attack. Trevor Rogers earned the win with a strong start, while Jovani Morán struck out 3 in 2 innings of relief. The Red Sox struggled to contain the Orioles' offense, allowing 8 runs on 10 hits.

**Yankees Outlast Guardians 2-1 in Low-Scoring Affair**

The New York Yankees edged the Cleveland Guardians 2-1, thanks to Carlos Rodón's 6-inning gem. Rodón struck out 7 and allowed just 1 earned run to earn the win. Trent Grisham was the only bright spot for the Guardians, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Yankees' solid pitching performance. Brent Headrick earned the save in the bottom of the 9th to seal the win.

**Giants Come from Behind to Top Brewers 12-9**

The San Francisco Giants rallied from a 6-4 deficit to defeat the Milwaukee Brewers 12-9 in a wild game. Jackson Chourio homered twice and drove in 4 runs to lead the Giants' offense, while Adrian Houser pitched 4.1 strong innings to earn the win. The Brewers' bullpen struggled to contain the Giants' attack, allowing 6 runs in the 8th inning to seal the loss.

**Blue Jays Shut Down Braves 7-2 Behind Sale's 5.2 Innings**

The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the Atlanta Braves 7-2, thanks to Chris Sale's 5.2-inning start. Sale struck out 6 and allowed just 3 earned runs to earn the win. Mauricio Dubón homered and drove in 1 run to lead the Blue Jays' offense, while Tyler Heineman added a key double in the 8th inning to seal the win.

**Royals Outlast Twins 8-6 in High-Scoring Affair**

The Kansas City Royals edged the Minnesota Twins 8-6 in a back-and-forth contest. Kody Clemens homered twice and drove in 2 runs to lead the Royals' offense, while Justin Lawrence struck out 2 in 0.2 innings of relief to earn the win. Josh Rojas added a late RBI single to seal the win for the Royals.

**Cubs Edge Athletics 7-6 in Thrilling Finale**

The Chicago Cubs outlasted the Oakland Athletics 7-6 in a thrilling finale. Shea Langeliers homered twice and drove in 3 runs to lead the Athletics' offense, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Cubs' late-inning surge. Ryan Rolison earned the win with a strong start, while J.T. Ginn struck out 8 in 6 innings of relief to earn the loss.

**Pirates Shut Down Astros 5-1 Behind Jones' 5-Inning Start**

The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Houston Astros 5-1, thanks to Jared Jones' 5-inning start. Jones struck out 4 and allowed just 0 earned runs to earn the win. Ryan O'Hearn homered and drove in 3 runs to lead the Pirates' offense, while Isaac Paredes added a late homer for the Astros.

**Diamondbacks Edge Dodgers 3-2 in Late-Inning Thriller**

The Arizona Diamondbacks edged the Los Angeles Dodgers 3-2 in a late-inning thriller. Corbin Carroll homered and drove in 1 run to lead the Diamondbacks' offense, while Justin Wrobleski pitched 6 strong innings to earn the win. Ketel Marte added a late homer for the Dodgers, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Diamondbacks' late-inning surge.
